SelectionBombIcon.png|Bomb that appeared to the left of bomb selection, before being replaced by the selected bomb. }} ==Skin Trivia== *The default skin of the '''Jester''' was originally a skin for the [[Scout]] tower which was modified into a full tower.[[File:JesterScoutSkinProof.png|280px]]
https://discord.com/channels/587355301083349002/600908514847883294/1198692467596349450 (Tower Defense Simulator Server) **The change from a skin to a tower happened during the development of the first act for the [[Lunar Overture Event]].[[File:JesterAct1DevelopmentProof.png|280px]]
https://discord.com/channels/587355301083349002/600908514847883294/1198692517139447959 (Tower Defense Simulator Server) **The various renders of the '''Jester''' have a different appearance which is due to this change from a skin to a tower.[[File:JesterRenderProof.png|280px]]
https://discord.com/channels/587355301083349002/600908514847883294/1178702964593016953 (Tower Defense Simulator Server) ***The background for the [[v1.9.0]] in-game update log and for the [[Lunar Overture Event]] season uses an early version of the [[Lunar Overture Event]] thumbnail. While bearing many differences, the '''Jester''' here is not put in as much focus as in the finished version of it, while also instead of wielding bombs it held something with its arms, which points towards this potentially being the Jester [[Scout]] skin.[[File:Halloween2023BP.png|280px]] *{{Color|CoinCrate|The Beast}} is based on Portuguese professional footballer [[wp:Cristiano Ronaldo|Cristiano Ronaldo]]. **The name of the skin is based on the nickname that Spanish sports broadcaster ''Manolo Lama'' coined when Cristiano Ronaldo played for Real Madrid, "''El Bicho''" (literal Spanish for "''bug''", though it has "creature" connotations)https://www.goal.com/en-gb/news/why-is-cristiano-ronaldo-called-el-bicho-manchester-united-star-s-the-bug-nickname-explained/blt1b98e5c28a369927. *{{Color|CoinCrate|The Flea}} is based on Argentine professional footballer [[wp:Lionel Messi|Lionel Messi]]. **{{Color|CoinCrate|The Flea}} skin name is based on Lionel Messi's nickname when he played for F.C. Barcelona, "''La Pulga''" (Spanish for "''flea''"). ***He is named as such due to his shorter stature compared to other professional footballers. *{{Color|CoinCrate|The Flea}} was a proposed skin that was first speculated after Argentina won the FIFA World Cup 2022 in Qatar. **The football kit used by {{Color|CoinCrate|The Beast}} is the Portuguese national team home kit used during the tournament.
